rows.ARS:
Orange blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MEIrestif
Exhibition name: Louis de Funès ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Marie-Louise (Louisette) Meilland (Paolino) (1920-1987) (France, before 1982).
Introduced in France by Meilland et Cie in 1984 as 'Louis de Funès'.
Introduced in Australia by Ross Roses in 1989 as 'Louis de Funès'.
rows.Bloom: Orange-red, yellow reverse. Mild fragrance. 15 to 30 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Medium, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 31" to 43" (80 to 110cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
